apiProducts.name: Account and Client Data
apiProducts.description: Account Aggregation (Balances, Positions, Transaction History), ACH Setup, Customer Profile and Statements for clients with Schwab.com credentials using FDX 3.0 and FDX 4.6, with OAuth 2.0 token-based authentication.

apiProducts.name: CUSTOMER_CONTACT
apiProducts.description: Client Profile: This product provides access to CUSTOMER_CONTACT data cluster. Client profile of the consenting client is shared for the selected account, along with their role on the account. This endpoint does NOT provide client profile of all clients on the account, or full account number(s). Scope: fdx:customercontact:read

apiProducts.name: FDX STATEMENTS
apiProducts.description: This product provides access to STATEMENTS data cluster. Provides account statements that are also available on Schwab.com for a given date range, up to 2 years in the past. A secure link to a downloadable PDF file is provided. Scope: fdx:statements:read

apiProducts.name: FDX_ACCOUNT_DETAILED
apiProducts.description: Detailed Account Information: This product provides access to ACCOUNT_DETAILED data cluster. Provides detailed account information beyond basic fields - ownership type, balances (cash, assets, margin, principal, unpaid balance, etc.), last activity date, and interest rate where applicable. This product does NOT include transaction history or full account number. Scope: fdx:accountdetailed:read

apiProducts.name: FDX_INVESTMENTS
apiProducts.description: This product provides access to INVESTMENTS data cluster. Focuses on positions and holdings within brokerage, retirement, and other supported products. This product does NOT include transaction history or full account number. Scope: fdx:investments:read

apiProducts.name: FDX_TAX
apiProducts.description: This product provides access to TAX data cluster. Provides 1099 tax statements that are also available on Schwab.com for a given date range, up to 2 years in the past. A secure link to a downloadable PDF file is provided. This product does NOT include 1099 structured data. Scope: fdx:tax:read

apiProducts.name: FDX_TRANSACTIONS
apiProducts.description: This product provides access to TRANSACTIONS data cluster. Includes Trade-level details for securities transactions, Contribution, distribution, rollover transactions, Deposits, withdrawals, transfers, ACH, checks, where applicable. Scope: fdx:investments:read + fdx:transactions:read

apiProducts.name: FDX CUSTOMER_CONTACT
apiProducts.description: Client Profile: This product provides access to CUSTOMER_CONTACT data cluster. Client profile of the consenting client is shared for the selected account, along with their role on the account. This endpoint does NOT provide client profile of all clients on the account, or full account number(s). Scope: fdx:customercontact:read

apiProducts.name: FDX PAYMENT_SUPPORT
apiProducts.description: Payment Networks (ACH): This product provides access to PAYMENT_SUPPORT data cluster. Full Account Number and Routing Transit Number for Checking and Savings accounts is shared. No other account types are supported. Scope: fdx:paymentnetworks:read

apiProducts.name: Statements
apiProducts.description: Provides access to statements for accounts Clients have selected

apiProducts.name: STATEMENTS
apiProducts.description: This product provides access to STATEMENTS data cluster. Provides account statements that are also available on Schwab.com for a given date range, up to 2 years in the past. A secure link to a downloadable PDF file is provided. Scope: fdx:statements:read
